info.title: Shuo UI
info.description: Markdown representations of every Shuo UI page, the documents agents discover the site through, and its MCP endpoint.

get.description: Returns HTML by default, Markdown when negotiated. Every page is available as Markdown. Append `.md` to the URL, or send `Accept: text/markdown` on the HTML URL. Known AI agent user agents receive Markdown by default.

200.description: The page as Markdown, with YAML frontmatter.

Vary.description: Always includes `Accept` and `User-Agent`. The page depends on both, and its Markdown representation carries the header too, since that is where a negotiated request is sent.

NotFoundMarkdown.description: The page does not exist. The body is a short Markdown document linking to the entry points an agent can recover from.

Linkset.description: RFC 9727 linkset. Each entry anchors a resource and points at its description and documentation.
